dedupe_keys.name: eesti teeregister estonian road register with public wfs and wms services transport administration

description: The Estonian road register (Eesti teeregister), kept by the Transport Administration (Transpordiamet), gathers the technical data of all publicly used roads in Estonia. The dataset page on the national open data portal, read on 2026-09-28 (last modified 11 February 2025), says the data are updated daily and are used by road administration staff and local government specialists for decisions on the road network, and lists eleven distributions: the register's statute, the road register itself, a map application, the TarkTee application, public WFS and WMS services and INSPIRE WFS and WMS services with their capabilities documents. Registers of this kind hold road geometry, classes, owners, surfaces and structures. Coverage is national, for state, local and private public roads. Access is free through the web services; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: the attribute list was not read, the INSPIRE services give a harmonised subset, and pages are in Estonian. It supports building national road network models for flow and accessibility analysis and hazard exposure studies of Estonian roads and bridges. No related Estonian road record is catalogued; OpenStreetMap and European road datasets complement it.
